overlapPolicy: identities present in more than one record are kept with every source recorded; none is dropped

defectFound.issue: checks only the blocks of the first and last seed of a range, so a range spanning more than two blocks can pass while an interior spent block is excluded
defectFound.disposition: committed closure code left unchanged; every future allocator must use exclusion/strict-index.mjs preflightNamespace (checks every block in the range)

calls: preflightNamespace(strict, {base, count}) for each candidate replication namespace
preflightWorlds(strict, [worldHash...]) at admission, before any policy call
allocatorIntegration.failureSemantics: any exception from loadStrictIndex, any failure from either preflight: refuse allocation/admission; never repair, skip or replace
allocatorIntegration.bindingRequirement: a future registration must bind the module and all record files (paths + sha256) in its candidate and re-verify them before allocation; the frozen V4 allocator (allocate-namespaces-v4.mjs) does NOT consume this index and must not be reused unchanged
allocatorIntegration.textScan: repository text search may be kept as an additional check but is never the exclusion authority

tests: exclusion/tests.mjs: 5/5 pass (counts; spent blocks, boundaries and recorded seeds; interior-block range; every identity source and non-canonical hashes; tampered or missing records throw)
